checks.summary: Strict TypeScript checking and the Solidity build passed for the isolated timeout runner and its bounded recovery command.
The isolated threshold slice verified Ethereum Sepolia, signer availability, pinned artifacts, and capped fresh-fixture deployment estimates without a write.
The bounded Sepolia continuation closed the threshold epoch, observed exactly the YES/NO public-decrypt ACL tuple, and recorded a real early-timeout reverted receipt.
The terminal Sepolia recovery cancelled permissionlessly, completed both refunds, verified the two owner balances with bounded Nox retries, and deleted the ignored local actor record.
292 recorded Sepolia writes consumed 181437336246064648 wei of the 500000000000000000 wei cumulative gas allowance; 318562663753935352 wei remains.

knownLimitations: Offline checks provide only static and deterministic validation. Contract, Nox, ACL, confidential-asset, lifecycle, and recovery evidence is solely the referenced Ethereum Sepolia execution.
FND-05C remains required for proof-context and delayed rewrap recovery acceptance.
reproduction: Use Node 24.18.0 and npm 11.16.0 with the committed lockfile and local secret configuration.
Inspect evidence/sepolia/G3/FND-05-TIMEOUT.json and its referenced Ethereum Sepolia receipts without exposing local recovery material.
